items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: it was kind of before Don Rickles, his whole act was to insult people.

ctx.x: Tell us a little more about working on the Tonight Show band.

Well it was a great experience. There again, as embarrassing moments — so I got the job, and that’s right Skitch Henderson had been the leader, but then there was some trouble there and he left, and Doc Severinsen, my good friend and a great trumpet player, and I was used to working with him in those days in the studios doing something. And he said, “Well I’m the band leader now,” you know, “I’d like you to do the job.” I said fine. So I show up. And you know you rehearse the music as much as you can, just once…
And you didn’t know this was coming?
